rules.title: San Francisco Annual Rent Increase for March 1, 2026 - February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, landlords may increase rent by up to 1.6% annually during the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 (as administered by Rent Board)
rules.quotedSpan: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

rules.coverageDescription: Rent-controlled units in San Francisco as defined by S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37. Coverage excludes owner-occupied buildings with two or fewer units and other exemptions under S.F.R.C. § 37.2(r).
exemptions: Owner-occupied buildings with two or fewer units

warnings: Source is an announcement of an annual allowable increase under existing San Francisco rent control law (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37) and does not state building-level coverage criteria. Complete coverage rules are in the underlying ordinance, not this announcement.

This source is a news announcement of the annual allowable rent increase for a specific 12-month period under San Francisco's existing rent control law. It does not define which buildings are covered; that is determined by S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 and its definitions and exemptions. A separate rule record for the underlying ordinance (S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37) would be needed to fully specify coverage.
